phrases: bitcoin you drop straight into the chat
pay, post, and chat in bitcoin
rules.reason: These artwork phrases describe mint-issued ecash as directly held bitcoin. Name digital cash and explain issuer trust (CLAIMS 1 and 11).

phrases: works with whatever wallet they use
the whole conversation loads with it
rules.reason: Known artwork overclaims omit wallet, provider, mint or relay limits. Describe the supported action (CLAIMS 11).

phrases: real reviews from people who use this mint
independent checks and reviews before you put money in
rules.reason: Reviews and operation checks do not establish reviewer experience, independence, issuer identity or reserves (CLAIMS 2 and 11).
Ranked feeds use algorithms; engagement counts do not establish authenticity (CLAIMS 11).
Local control of keys and proofs does not remove mint custody of backing funds (CLAIMS 1).
Describe the specific blinding or encryption boundary, not anonymity or absence of metadata (CLAIMS 2 and 4).
Relays, mints, and other services can restrict access or become unavailable (CLAIMS 5).

phrases: only way to get your money back
your words are all you need
rules.reason: Recovery depends on mint URLs, supported records, keys, and availability (CLAIMS 3).
Fees and completion depend on the operation, mint, and payment rail (CLAIMS 6).
Do not generalize repository access to the full product, services, assets, or dependencies (CLAIMS 8).
Review the subject, threat model, metadata, and storage qualifications. These words are not prohibited.
Review timing, cost, compatibility, settlement, and recovery qualifications. These words are not prohibited.
Check channel, region, version, source and licensing evidence before publishing (CLAIMS 7 and 8).

exceptions.context: Sovran is not anonymous by default.
exceptions.reason: Exact explanatory negation in the Privacy Policy, not permission for a positive claim elsewhere.

exceptions.context: Ecash blinding limits certain links; it does not make every payment or network request untraceable.
exceptions.reason: Exact explanation of the limit of blinding. No other text in these files is exempt.
